reason: typescript-eslint 8.71 peers typescript >=4.8.4 <6.1.0, so a bump to 7.x makes both npm install and npm ci fail with ERESOLVE and the tree stops resolving.
lift: A typescript-eslint major whose peer range admits the next TypeScript release; bump both in one commit and drop the Dependabot ignore.

lift: When the three plugins' peer ranges admit the next ESLint major, or the overrides are removed with them; then drop the Dependabot ignore in the same commit.
